name: Elif's room in cozy, clean flat.
description:
10 min by bus you can get to Piazza Venezia or Colosseum. All shops, gym, many trendy&local restaurants and cafes walking distance.
30min from beaches of Ostia and Fiumicino airport by direct train.
5 min away from metro B line Piramide stop.
EATALY is 5 min walking away where you can eat and shop the most quality Italian food from 9 am to midnight.
There is big supermarket open 7/24m just 2 min walking.
neighborhood_overview:
It used to be an industrial area until late 80s.
Now all the factories have became museums, cultural centers, shops, restaurants, university buildings.
It's next to well known Testaccio, Garbatella, Aventino, S.Saba and S.Paolo.
It's quite lively especially weekend nights.
You can have great time in the excellently located flat.
Capitolino Museums and Basilica di S.Paolo which is one of the four big churches of Rome is 15 min walking distance.
The only Roman Piramid left from Roman times is just around the corner, next to Protestant cemetery which is one of the most poetic place to visit in the city. There is lovely small museum with free entrance on the Porta San Paolo.
host_about:
I am a Turkish-Italian who was born in Istanbul, travelled in different countries for livning or  visiting  and has been living in Rome since 1998. I live with my three daughters. We speak Turkish, English, Italian, Spanish.
We love traveling and meeting new people. When we are on holiday we don't like staying in the hotels and feeling like a tourist so we rather prefer living in local people's houses and feel like the real life or the place. That's also why we opened our house to people to make them comfortable and feel like locals while they are in Rome.
If you want to come to Rome and feel comfortably as your own home, meet other housemates, live in a non touristic neighborhood but in the same time, be very close to down town, you are in the right place!
Looking forward to meeting you!

name: ✧Termini Terrace B&B✧ is 150 mt From Termini ST 3
description:
Termini Terrace is an elegant Bed and Breakfast with a wonderful terrace.
It is located in the centre of Rome and about 150 metres from Termini station, where all means of transport connect: many trains come and go, as well as the two metro lines, the city buses and the airport shuttles.

From this privileged position it's easy to reach Rome's main touristic sites in a few minutes by foot, such as the Colosseum, the Trevi Fountain, and the main shopping streets.

We are waiting for you!
neighborhood_overview:
The neighborhood where we are located is part of the historic center and goes from Termini Station to the Esquilino.

Roma Termini is the main railway station of the city and its name derives from the ancient Baths of Diocletian which are located in front of the main entrance.

Esquilino is one of the famous Seven Hills where the city of Rome was founded, dating back to the 8th century B.C. Patrons lived there: Mecenate, Horace, Virgilio, Properzio and other illustrious personalities.

Now Esquilino is one of the best ethnic district in Rome, a virtuous example of racial integration, in continuity with the ancient Roman multiethnic attitude.

Here you will be able to get lost in a world full of colors, scents and flavors that evokes distant lands.

Mi prenderò cura del vostro soggiorno garantendovi la migliore esperienza di soggiorno.

description:
Giulia Apartment by AdG is located in an ancient building dating back to the 1500s, part of the historic Palazzo Sacchetti condominium. It is a charming apartment designed to offer you an unforgettable experience in the enchanting heart of Rome.

With a pleasant stroll from the most aristocratic and romantic street (the quiet Via Giulia), you can visit the main attractions of the Eternal City, such as Piazza Navona, Castel Sant'Angelo, the Trevi Fountain, and much more.
neighborhood_overview:
Via Giulia is one of the most charming and historic streets in Rome, located in the heart of the historic center. The street was designed in 1508 by Pope Julius II as a grand avenue that would cross the Ponte district, connecting the Tiber River to the Trastevere district. Its construction was part of a papal desire to beautify the city and create a representative street, intended to become a symbol of power and beauty.

The street is characterized by an elegant and noble appearance, with Renaissance and Baroque palaces alternating with churches and historic monuments. Via Giulia winds through a part of Rome rich in history, close to many points of interest, making it an ideal destination for walks among the city’s art and culture, such as: Piazza Navona, Castel Sant'Angelo, Palazzo Farnese, and much more.
